name: social_media_image_urls
how_collected: The main sweep in social_posts.json recorded only a has_media boolean and discarded the URLs. These were recovered by re-running the same 7 AOI phrases against Twitter/X (sort=Latest) plus 2 earlier sort=Top calls, then deduped on post URL.
caveats: Twitter/X only. YouTube items in the sweep carry thumbnails, but those URLs were not collected.
Image URLs are hotlinks to pbs.twimg.com and may expire or be deleted by the poster; they are not archived copies.
These are third-party photographs. The three reproduced in Report.pdf are illustrative file images of EARLIER tests — none depicts the 6-7 August 2026 trial, which had not occurred at capture.
